name: Laban
summary: Rebekah's brother, who later became Jacob's father-in-law. He gave Jacob Leah when Jacob had worked for Rachel, but in the end he and Jacob made a covenant of peace.

key_moments.title: Welcoming Abraham's Servant
key_moments.description: Laban ran out to meet Abraham's servant at the well and brought him home. He and Bethuel agreed that Rebekah should go and marry Isaac.

key_moments.title: Gives Jacob Leah Instead of Rachel
key_moments.description: Jacob worked seven years for Laban's daughter Rachel, but Laban brought him Leah in the evening, and in the morning Jacob saw he had been deceived. Laban gave him Rachel too, for seven more years of work.

key_moments.title: Chasing Jacob
key_moments.description: When Jacob fled with his family, Laban chased him to mount Gilead. God warned Laban in a dream not to speak against Jacob, and Laban asked why Jacob had stolen his gods.

key_moments.title: Makes a Covenant with Jacob
key_moments.description: Laban and Jacob piled up stones as a witness to their covenant, agreeing that neither would pass it to harm the other. Laban kissed his daughters and grandchildren, blessed them, and went home.
